title: Discover technical context through the CLI
statement: As an Architect or Developer directing AI work, I can query Systems, Components, their relationships, code, and usages so the AI can identify reusable entities and the relevant code subset before exploring raw source.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Public queries return discoverable System and Component identities, descriptions, explicit proposal/existence information, and code-reference health.
Starting from a System, public queries expose its Component relationships and their exact code references so a caller can identify and select a relevant subset.
Queries expose implementation-deck usages and their originating Items so a caller can find existing feature precedent.
Query results distinguish missing evidence or links from confirmed absence and identify historical, stale, or conflicted records instead of presenting them as current facts.
